PAGE_1_TEXT.RESTAURANTS_DESC_1: A sushi bar — a modern classic of Japanese cuisine
PAGE_1_TEXT.RESTAURANTS_DESC_2: Everything here is designed to help our guests enjoy their time in a relaxed atmosphere and take pleasure in great food, rest, and conversation. Our menu offers a wide variety of dishes, an abundance of flavors, and a delicate approach to Japanese cuisine.
PAGE_1_TEXT.BOTTOM_DESC: WE VALUE EVERY CUSTOMER and we do everything to ensure that you enjoy your visit to our restaurants and taste the best dishes of Japanese cuisine

PAGE_3_TEXT.TITLE: SPECIAL OFFERS
PAGE_3_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Traditions of Japan, the taste of your city!
